name: ryan-dam
description: Local-first digital asset manager for creators

scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:web
scripts.build:backend: npm run prepare:ffmpeg && .venv\Scripts\python.exe -m PyInstaller --noconfirm --clean --onefile --name ryan-dam-api --paths . --collect-all fastapi --collect-all uvicorn --collect-all pydantic --collect-all starlette --collect-all alembic --add-data "backend/alembic;alembic" --add-binary "ffmpeg-bin/ffmpeg.exe;ffmpeg" --add-binary "ffmpeg-bin/ffprobe.exe;ffmpeg" --hidden-import uvicorn.logging --hidden-import uvicorn.loops.auto --hidden-import uvicorn.protocols.http.auto --hidden-import uvicorn.lifespan.on --distpath backend/dist --workpath backend/build backend/launcher.py
scripts.package:win: npm run build:backend && npm run build && electron-builder --win nsis --publish never
